style: bold editorial kinetic type, dark with one hot accent flip
brief: A self-aware reel about its own length. A countdown clock in the corner and a draining progress bar run the full 10 seconds. Copy lands in four beats: Hook 'YOU HAVE 10 SECONDS' (the 10 slams in, in orange), Build 'TO STOP THE SCROLL.' (words whip in from alternating sides), Punch 'MAKE EVERY SECOND COUNT.' (pattern interrupt: the whole frame flips to orange, words pop on a staccato beat), Resolve 'Used well.' as the clock hits 00:00. One motif: time running out.

scenes.motion: alternating side whips, vertical whip exit
orange flip, staccato pop, scale pulse
scale settle, soft reveal, final hold

content.block: hand-authored (caption-kinetic-slam is single-word captions; reel needs stacked lines + persistent clock)
